scope.device: 2D n-IGZO electron-only drift-diffusion teaching model with the T02-A enabled symmetric dual-gate stack
scope.purpose: Freeze literature-constrained acceptor-like bulk tail and Gaussian deep-state equations, units, isolated three-point scans, and the equation-smoke gate without running DEVSIM.
fixed_variables: bottom and top interface D_it = 0 cm^-2 eV^-1 during bulk-only scans
inactive bulk family peak density = 0 cm^-3 eV^-1 during each isolated scan
channel length = 10 um and width = 60 um
top and bottom physical Al2O3 thickness = 30 nm
top and bottom dielectric relative permittivity = 6.8
no recombination, dynamic capture-emission, ferroelectric polarization, or non-ideal contacts
prohibited_work: bulk-trap DEVSIM equation smoke or transfer simulation before this contract passes
simultaneous NTA and NGA variation in one attribution scan
simultaneous interface D_it and bulk-trap variation
dynamic trapping, SRH recombination, hysteresis, bias-stress, or reliability claims
experimental fitting or project-device DOS extraction
physical Ion/Ioff or calibrated SS/VTH claims
P3, P5, compact-model, SPICE, circuit, layout, or HZO work

literature_input.title: Numerical Study of Sub-Gap Density of States Dependent Electrical Characteristics in Amorphous In-Ga-Zn-O Thin-Film Transistors
literature_input.source_device_context: top-contact bottom-gate staggered a-IGZO TFT, 100 nm SiO2, W/L=100/10 um, VD=40 V
literature_input.project_mismatch: The project uses a symmetric dual gate, 30 nm physical Al2O3 on each side, 24 nm IGZO, ideal contacts, and a 0.01 V drain bias; source values constrain teaching sensitivities only.
literature_input.nomenclature_resolution: The paper equation and Table 1 classify NGA as acceptor-like, while the Figure 3 caption says donor-like. This contract follows the equation/table and preserves that conflict as a limitation.
literature_input.energy_reference_translation: Use epsilon=Ec-E in eV. The paper's conduction-tail equation becomes exp(-epsilon/WTA), and its Ec-E description places the Gaussian acceptor peak EGA below Ec.

tail.selection_rule: Use the reported lower point, Table 1 reference point, and upper point; retain 1e19 in provenance without adding a fourth formal device.

deep.selection_rule: Use the reported lower point, Table 1 reference point, and upper point; retain 1e17 in provenance without adding a fourth formal device.

occupancy_assumptions: local quasi-static equilibrium with the mobile-electron quasi-Fermi level
acceptor-like states are neutral when empty and carry one negative elementary charge when occupied
bulk_trap_model.effective_conduction_dos_source: config/tcad_t01_baseline.json teaching assumption; not the paper's 5e18 value
bulk_trap_model.electron_continuity_coupling: No trap generation-recombination term in this quasi-static first implementation; only the Poisson charge Jacobian couples to Electrons.
bulk_trap_model.charge_unit_derivation: DOS[cm^-3 eV^-1] integrated over eV gives occupied density[cm^-3]; multiplication by q gives C/cm^3.
bulk_trap_model.zero_density_limit: NTA=NGA=0 gives OccupiedBulkTraps=0 and exactly restores the trap-free T02-C Poisson charge expression.
limitations: Nc, bandgap, mobility, contacts, and background doping remain teaching assumptions rather than a jointly calibrated IGZO material set.
Local equilibrium occupancy has no capture cross section or time constant and cannot produce hysteresis or bias-stress dynamics.
Only acceptor-like NTA and NGA are included; donor-like NTD and NGD are deferred.
The source device and bias differ from this project, so the literature values are sensitivity inputs rather than project measurements.

energy_integration.implementation_rule: Generate nodes and weights once in Python, then emit the finite weighted sum and analytic Electrons derivative as DEVSIM node-model expressions.

execution_order: tail scan with NGA=0 and both interface D_it values zero
deep scan with NTA=0 and both interface D_it values zero
registered_hypotheses: Increasing occupied acceptor-like bulk states may increase the VTH and SS numerical proxies.
Increasing occupied acceptor-like bulk states may reduce common-bias mobile-electron density and drain-current proxies.
future_sensitivity.reason_hypotheses_not_gates: The literature stack, quasi-static occupancy, and project teaching material set differ, so convergence, conservation, zero-limit regression, extractability, and persisted evidence determine completion.

required_checks: 96-point quadrature agrees with an independent reference integration
zero trap density restores T02-C node charge and common-bias current
occupied trap density and analytic Electrons derivative are finite and nonnegative
physical trapped charge is nonpositive and DEVSIM node source has the opposite sign
all coupled solves converge and source/drain current is conserved
tail-only and deep-only cases produce a nonzero persisted response

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: A passed contract may claim only that one E1 IGZO source, normalized NTA/NGA equations, quasi-static occupancy, units, isolated literature point sets, quadrature accuracy gates, and a minimum equation-smoke plan have been frozen and statically checked.
prohibited_claims: bulk-trap DEVSIM simulation, convergence, current conservation, or response has passed
bulk NTA or NGA sensitivity has completed
project-device DOS has been measured, extracted, fitted, or calibrated
physical SS, VTH, Ioff, Ion, mobility, hysteresis, or reliability has been validated
compact-model, circuit, layout, or HZO evidence exists
evidence_boundary.next_gate: Only this contract PASS permits the separate T03-P2-BULK-TRAPS equation smoke. The smoke and its independent persisted-evidence check must pass before any formal NTA/NGA transfer scan; P3, P5, SPICE, and layout remain closed.
